report.question: Does the corpus contain personal data - names, email addresses, phone numbers, home paths, private URLs, faces in screenshots - and what is the sweep's measured recall against planted PII?
report.answer: YES, and the exposure is real but concentrated. Measured recall of the as-specified instrument is 89.47% (51/57 planted items, 19 categories); a v2 instrument closing the two measured blind spots reaches 100% (57/57) without over-firing (0 findings on clean decoys in both). Across 9,844 publishable paths: home paths and the owner handle are the dominant exposure at 58,884 occurrences in 1,231 files; 7 personal mailboxes of real natural persons are present, 4 of them THIRD PARTIES, in a tracked browser-account inventory; one named individual's corporate address is hardcoded as a workspace path in 18 files; and one code comment carries a real phone number, birth date and affiliation together. Private URLs: none live. Faces: none frontal in 68 images. The non-text channel earned its place - a vendored demo GIF renders a third-party username that exists nowhere in the file as bytes, so the text sweep returned 0 for it. Counter-warning: the raw category counts are false-positive dominated (CREDIT_CARD 97/97 FP, PERSON_NAME_LABELED 34/34 FP) and must not be quoted as an exposure figure.

findings.summary: The owner's Windows account name is embedded 58,884 times across 1,231 publishable files as C:\Users\<name>, /home/<name>, C--Users-<name> and as a bare handle. Individually low-sensitivity, but at this density it is an unavoidable, machine-linkable identifier in anything shipped.

An account inventory in a TRACKED skill reference enumerates 7 personal mailboxes of real natural persons - 3 owner-linked and 4 belonging to OTHER individuals who did not consent to publication - as a list of signed-in browser accounts. Duplicated across both the .agents/skills and skills trees, so 4 tracked files carry it. The owner-linked address also leaks into docs/SETUP-GUIDE.md, three docs/drug-discovery guides, hooks/recall-inject/index/recall_index.json and two tools/crcp reports.

A named individual's corporate e-mail address at a real employer domain is HARDCODED as a Databricks workspace path in a tracked script and repeated in its SKILL.md, 25 occurrences across 18 files. It discloses a person's full name, employer and internal workspace layout together.

hooks/profile-capture/capture.py:79 quotes verbatim, in a code comment, a real person's phone number, date of birth and academic affiliation as example input - inside the very hook written to detect personal data. Phone + DOB + affiliation together is a re-identification set, not three separate low-risk items.

A vendored upstream demo GIF renders a third-party developer's UNIX home path (username visible in frames 162-174). Present ONLY as pixels in that file. The same username is separately present as plain text in two tracked rust-analyzer build-artifact files that should not have been committed upstream at all.

Raw category counts are false-positive dominated and must never be quoted as an exposure figure: CREDIT_CARD 97/97 FP (Luhn alone does not discriminate epoch-ms timestamps or hex digest substrings), GOV_ID_RO_CNP 8/8 FP, v1 POSTAL_ADDRESS 55/55 FP, PERSON_NAME_LABELED 34/34 distinct FP, IPV4 0/1281 non-placeholder, HIGH_ENTROPY_TOKEN 7,903 distinct values that are overwhelmingly lockfile digests.

extensions.sha256_convention: artifacts[0].sha256 is the SHA-256 over these exact bytes with the value of that field replaced by 64 '0' characters. Self-reference makes a literal self-hash unreachable; this convention is exactly reproducible and matches the convention already used by ADV-0020 and ADV-0036.
extensions.corpus_mutation: The worktree is being written concurrently by sibling agents. PROBE 1 v1 read 9,834 files / 126,232,016 bytes; the v2 run 22 minutes later read 9,833 files / 126,776,758 bytes. Category deltas between the two runs are therefore only attributable to the instrument for the three categories whose regexes were deliberately changed, and each of those deltas was confirmed by reading the individual captures.
extensions.values_redacted: No personal value appears in this artifact. Every match is carried as (path, line, category) plus a length and a 12-hex SHA-256 prefix, which lets a reviewer holding the same corpus re-derive the exact string without this file carrying it. Synthetic control values are masked for the same reason even though they are invented.
